name: atlas-suite-plugin
description: Provider-neutral agent interface for deterministic repository Atlases, KG-RAG workflows, bounded context, and Project Atlas frontend generation.

interface.shortDescription: Build, query, and present deterministic governed Atlas projections.
interface.longDescription: Atlas Suite provides Project, Context, Knowledge, Topology, and Evidence-Rules Atlas skills, a source-grounded KG-RAG Specialist, and an Atlas Frontend Designer for content/CSS-only presentation refinement. It delegates deterministic execution to the paired dkg framework and never grants protected-effect authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate Atlas Suite skill to produce a deterministic, cited, proof-bounded result.
